title: New Zealand vs India, 3rd T20I, Hnry Stadium, Wellington, 27 Oct 2026: India's record powerplay
publisher: ESPNcricinfo match pages (full scorecard, overs comparison, match stats, match report), read 27 Oct 2026; earlier records from ESPNcricinfo scorecards
notes: T20I no. 4221. Toss: India, elected to field. New Zealand 198/3 (20 ov); India 199/4 (13.2 ov, target 199). India won by 6 wickets with 40 balls remaining; India lead the five-match series 3-0.
Match flow: 'Powerplay: Overs 0.1 - 6.0 (Mandatory - 118 runs, 0 wicket)'; India 50 in 2.2 overs (15 balls), 100 in 4.6 overs (31 balls). Abhishek Sharma 50 off 15 balls, 100 off 35 balls.

Match report (Karthik Krishnaswamy): 'a T20I record 118 for no loss in a powerplay'; fifty in 2.2 overs 'a joint-record for T20Is where ball-by-ball data is available'; required rate 9.95 at the start, 5.78 after the powerplay; first over 26 off Jacob Duffy, with a no-ball and a bouncer wided for height that ran to the boundary.

Romania 116/0 vs Serbia (Sofia, 26 Jun 2021) was a chase of 116 completed in 5.4 overs, so not a full six-over powerplay. Australia 113/1 vs Scotland (Edinburgh, 4 Sep 2024) is a full six-over powerplay.
